finalDailyBrowserSuite.agents: Deterministic fake CLIs for browser regressions; separate from the real live run above

fullSuite.remainingFailure: Regression fixture reserved turn 5 for a read-only side chat; adding the legacy-review case changed that turn. Real Codex corrected the fixture to write only in write mode, preserving all assertions. The entire 27-test engine file then passed.
fullSuite.earlierFailure: An earlier full suite hit an ENOTEMPTY temporary-directory cleanup race. Bounded cleanup retries were added and both affected tests passed.

limits: Claude inference was not exercised because Claude Code was signed out. Its unavailable-selection behavior was exercised against the real health report.
The live workflow used local execution. SSH, containers and external PR publication are outside this live run.

Antigravity planning and review took several minutes. The cancelled initial planning turn, its resume, and timings are retained above. The updated planning prompt was covered by pattern tests; latency improvement was not claimed from a new live planning run.
Final revisions correctly invalidate the initial independent approval; the final local merge was owner-reviewed and verified, without claiming a new independent review.

automatedReviewCorrections.sourceOptions: CI-log inclusion changes in either direction and alert-tool/number changes refresh source context. Refreshing options for the same PR retains the selected pinned commit even after the remote PR advances.
